For now, use Firefox or change your DNS server) Or, hide this message: temporarily or permanently Positive Crankcase Ventilation: Description and Operation PCV System: PURPOSE The Positive Crankcase Ventilation ( PCV ) System cycles crankcase gases back through the engine where they are burned.  On some engine applications, the PCV system is connected to the evaporative emission system. NOTE: Do not remove the PCV system from the engine.  Removal of the PCV system will adversely affect fuel economy and engine ventilation resulting in shorter engine life. pro multis · About Operation CHARM

NOTE: Do not remove the PCV system from the engine.
